# Test BOLERO_MODCACHE
env BOLERO_MODULE=on

# Explicitly set BOLERO_MODCACHE
env BOLERO_MODCACHE=$WORK/modcache
bolero env BOLERO_MODCACHE
stdout $WORK[/\\]modcache
bolero get rsc.io/quote@v1.0.0
exists $WORK/modcache/cache/download/rsc.io/quote/@v/v1.0.0.info
grep '{"Version":"v1.0.0","Time":"2018-02-14T00:45:20Z"}' $WORK/modcache/cache/download/rsc.io/quote/@v/v1.0.0.info

# Ensure BOLERO_MODCACHE doesn't affect location of sumdb, but $BOLERO_MODCACHE/cache/download/sumdb is still written
exists $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/sumdb
! exists $WORK/modcache/sumdb
exists $WORK/modcache/cache/download/sumdb

# Test that the default BOLERO_MODCACHE is $BOLERO_PATH[0]/pkg/mod
env BOLERO_MODCACHE=
bolero env BOLERO_MODCACHE
stdout $BOLERO_PATH[/\\]pkg[/\\]mod
bolero get rsc.io/quote@v1.0.0
exists $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/rsc.io/quote/@v/v1.0.0.info
grep '{"Version":"v1.0.0","Time":"2018-02-14T00:45:20Z"}' $BOLERO_PATH/pkg/mod/cache/download/rsc.io/quote/@v/v1.0.0.info

# If neither BOLERO_MODCACHE or BOLERO_PATH are set, BOLERO_PATH defaults to the user's $HOME/bolero, so BOLERO_MODCACHE becomes $HOME/bolero/pkg/mod
[GOOS:windows] env USERPROFILE=$WORK/home # Ensure USERPROFILE is a valid path (rather than /no-home/ so we don't run into the logic that "uninfers" BOLERO_PATH in cmd/go/main.go
[GOOS:plan9] env home=$WORK/home
[!GOOS:windows] [!GOOS:plan9] env HOME=$WORK/home
env BOLERO_MODCACHE=
env BOLERO_PATH=
bolero env BOLERO_MODCACHE
stdout $HOME[/\\]bolero[/\\]pkg[/\\]mod

# If BOLERO_MODCACHE isn't set and BOLERO_PATH starts with the path list separator,
# BOLERO_MODCACHE is empty and any command that needs it errors out.
env BOLERO_MODCACHE=
env BOLERO_PATH=${:}$WORK/this/is/ignored

bolero env BOLERO_MODCACHE
stdout '^$'
! stdout .
! stderr .

! bolero mod download rsc.io/quote@v1.0.0
stderr '^bolero: module cache not found: neither BOLERO_MODCACHE nor BOLERO_PATH is set$'

# If BOLERO_MODCACHE isn't set and BOLERO_PATH has multiple elements only the first is used.
env BOLERO_MODCACHE=
env BOLERO_PATH=$WORK/first/path${:}$WORK/this/is/ignored
bolero env BOLERO_MODCACHE
stdout $WORK[/\\]first[/\\]path[/\\]pkg[/\\]mod

env BOLERO_MODCACHE=$WORK/modcache
bolero mod download rsc.io/quote@v1.0.0
exists $WORK/modcache/cache/download/rsc.io/quote/@v/v1.0.0.info

# Test error when cannot create BOLERO_MODCACHE directory
env BOLERO_MODCACHE=$WORK/modcachefile
! bolero install example.com/cmd/a@v1.0.0
stderr 'bolero: could not create module cache'

# Test that the following work even with BOLERO_MODULE=off
env BOLERO_MODULE=off

# Cleaning modcache
exists $WORK/modcache
env BOLERO_MODCACHE=$WORK/modcache
bolero clean -modcache
! exists $WORK/modcache

-- go.mod --
module m

-- $WORK/modcachefile --
